profile_text.body:
Runway is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY, USA. On its own site the company describes itself as building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world, with products and services built on top of that intelligence to help individuals and organizations do more. Its tracked product is listed under video generation and editing, with the note that it covers video generation.

The site presents GWM-1 as its state-of-the-art General World Model, described as built to interact with the real world and as a step toward universal simulation, powering components that range from policy inference and evaluation to synthetic data generation. It also introduces Solaris, described as the company's first Interface World Model, real-time AI that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame with no code. The site promotes an enterprise video generation discussion covering themes such as data sovereignty, cost economics, autonomous execution and model ownership, and advertises a Runway AI Summit on 9/30 in San Francisco with speakers from DeepMind, NVIDIA and Physical Intelligence.

Court records held for the company list several cases: David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. in the District Court for the Southern District of New York and again in the Central District of California, Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc. and Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc, both in the Southern District of New York, and Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. in the Northern District of California. The company's litigation exposure is concentrated in New York. No MCP server is listed for it.
